title: Stein Solution Factors via Mills Ratios: Affine Birth Rates and Symmetric Potential Distributions
summary: We study Stein solution factors for indicator test functions by a common Mills-ratio method in discrete and continuous settings. In the discrete case, a general birth--death formulation gives exact solution envelopes and recovers the first-increment theory of Brown and Xia. For binomial and Poisson targets, and for negative binomial targets with shape parameter $r\ge1$, the additional algebraic structure of affine birth rates yields improved uniform bounds for the Stein solution.
